summary_en: A light Sunday. Vitalik described a self-experiment: a local model handles his personal health and travel data, and only the parts with no private information go to frontier models. On the spec side, EIP-8288 binds the block dependency hash to the aggregation circuit digest, and EIP-7928 aligns pre-state validation costs for EXT-style opcodes.
